map.坝体自重 W = ρc·g·H·B；静水压力 P = ½·γw·h²；扬压力 U: Dam self weight W = ρc·g·H·B; hydrostatic pressure P = ½·γw·h²; uplift U = α·γw·h·B taken as half (triangular distribution); sliding safety factor Ks = f·(W − U) ÷ P; overturning safety factor K0 = ΣM_stable ÷ ΣM_overturning
map.重力坝静力稳定按抗滑与抗倾覆两项校核。抗滑以坝底摩擦系数 f 乘有效法向力（自重: Gravity dam static stability checks sliding and overturning. Sliding uses the base friction coefficient f times the effective normal force (self weight minus uplift) divided by horizontal hydrostatic pressure, giving Ks; overturning uses the stabilising moment (self-weight and uplift moments) over the overturning moment (hydrostatic pressure moment), giving K0. Upstream water depth sets the hydrostatic pressure and uplift, and the uplift reduction coefficient α reflects the pressure relief from the curtain and drainage.
